title: Release plan amendments post-T0: gaos account, mirror+cleanup cut, v1-v7 benchmarks excluded as invalid, local-env deps must ship
summary: User amendments (2026-06-10, after ZONOID ratification): (1) zonoid.dev purchased; repo lives under the existing gaos GitHub account — no separate org. (2) Repo cut: NOT a single squashed commit — mirror the tree and do cleanup as real commits, with the hard invariant that sensitive material (held-out JSONL transcripts, agents.json blobs, personal paths) never exists in ANY pushed commit: clean locally first, push only when history is sensitive-free; cosmetic cleanup (README rewrite, renames) may be visible commits. (3) BENCHMARK VALIDITY RULING: v1–v7 competitive ON-vs-OFF results are INVALID — the test was shipped with the task (contamination); do not ship those artifacts. Receipts story must rest on still-valid artifacts (held-out n=1/n=2 protocol, temporal/retrieval benches, v8+ — triage opened); public claims citing v1–v7 numbers (1.63x→1.03x parity, v5 1.29x over-work, over-deliberation tax) need re-derivation or reframing before launch. (4) Orchestrator depends on locally patched environment (hooks/rules in ~/.claude, router/gate registrations, workspace CLAUDE.md conventions) — a ship-manifest audit is required so cold installs work; plugin packaging must carry these. (5) Positioning sharpening in progress: user's proposed angle — only system that tracks where tokens are actually spent across conversation → research → real work → real result via the graph.
